Line: Bob bought Josh Allen for a dollar in 2018. Joe paid $3, Farber $11, Brian and Ron $72, Ed $72. By 2023 Mike was paying $79.
Todd has bought Stephen Gostkowski at eight different auctions, from 2011 to 2019. No owner has gone back to one player more often.
The most anyone has ever paid at a MAFFL auction: Matt Brown, $96, Aaron Rodgers, 2012. He's been bought 20 times since, and in 2025 he went for $1.
No running back has ever cost more than LaDainian Tomlinson's $94 (Jake, 2008). Two years later Dave got him for $8.
Travis Kelce is the priciest tight end in league history at $69 (Fetrow, 2021). Fetrow has bought him four times.
Antonio Brown went for $1 to Brian and Ron in 2011. In 2016 BJ paid $76, still the most ever spent on a wide receiver.
Johnson got Michael Vick for a dollar in 2010. A year later Brian and Ron paid $77 for him.
Mike bought Matthew Stafford for $1 in 2009, then paid $86 for him in 2012. In 2013 he went for $32.
Rob Gronkowski: a dollar to Matt Brown in 2010, $62 to Joe in 2015.
Josh Farber was in the league for one season, 2020, and spent a dollar of it on Justin Jefferson. Three years later BJ paid $66.
Austin Ekeler's price tag: $1 (Jon and Rick, 2018), $71 (Dan, 2022), $65 (Dave, 2023), $5 (BJ, 2024).
Fetrow paid $85 for Jonathan Taylor in 2022. BJ got him for $13 in 2023, and Jon and Rick paid $60 in 2024.
Two straight champions built around Jahmyr Gibbs: Joe paid $60 for him in 2024 and won it all, then Jon and Rick paid $63 in 2025 and did the same.
Josh Lavrinc bought Patrick Mahomes for $12 in 2018; Ed paid $65 for him in 2019. After Braiden's $77 in 2024, Mike got him for $16 in 2025.
BJ won the 2019 title without spending more than $35 on anyone (Devonta Freeman). No champion has won with a cheaper top buy.
Jake bought Drew Brees at five auctions, including his 2011 title season. Brees has been on four championship rosters, more than any other player.
Ray Rice: $3 to Tony in 2008, the centerpiece of Dave's 2012 title at $81, $83 to Jon and Rick in 2013, then back to Tony for $16.
Johnson paid $71 for Tyreek Hill in 2024. A year later BJ got him for $9.
Jake paid $65 for Nick Chubb in 2023, then bought him back for $3 in 2024.
Mike Licciardi paid $70 for Kareem Hunt in 2018. In 2019 Dan got him for $6.
Dave bought Michael Thomas for $3 in 2016 and paid $50 for him again in 2017. BJ paid $65 in 2020; Todd got him for $3 in 2021.
Baker Mayfield sold for $1 or $2 at four auctions (2018, 2022, 2023, 2024). Then Fetrow paid $51 for him in 2025.
Brandon Jacobs: a dollar to Josh Lavrinc in 2005, $69 to Jimmy Crisan in 2009, $8 to Johnson in 2010.
Todd has bought Drew Brees, Aaron Rodgers and Tom Brady four times each.
Mike's $92 for Adrian Peterson in 2009 was the biggest buy of that auction.
